name: High Inquisitor Fairbanks
summary: In the Scarlet Crusade, High Inquisitor Fairbanks's fate remains bound to the order's dark descent. Before Lordaeron fell, he was a revered priest and a trusted advisor to Highlord Alexandros Mograine.

sections.title: Advisor to the Ashbringer
sections.body: Before Lordaeron fell, Fairbanks was a respected priest of the Knights of the Silver Hand. Highlord Alexandros Mograine trusted him above all others. Mograine bore the Ashbringer. Fairbanks stood beside Mograine, High General Abbendis and Grand Inquisitor Isillien when they founded the Scarlet Crusade, an order sworn to destroy the Scourge.

sections.title: Betrayal at Stratholme
sections.body:
Fairbanks accompanied Alexandros Mograine when Renault, the Highlord’s eldest son, led them into a Scourge ambush outside Stratholme. Undead claws brought Fairbanks down early, and heaps of rotting corpses buried him. Beneath them, he saw Renault take the fallen Ashbringer and drive it into his father’s heart. The patricide corrupted the holy blade.

Fairbanks survived the slaughter and clawed free of the dead. He returned to the Scarlet Monastery to expose Renault’s treachery.

sections.title: Execution and Exile
sections.body:
Fairbanks’s warnings split Lordaeron’s remaining defenders. Those who believed him left the fanatical order and formed the Argent Dawn. Those still loyal to Renault and Saidan Dathrohan branded him a blasphemer and lunatic.

The Scarlet Crusade executed Fairbanks in secret. The crusaders denied him a holy burial and cast his body into a hidden chamber behind the Cathedral’s altar. There, he eventually rose as the very monstrosity they had sworn to cleanse.

faq.q: Where can I find High Inquisitor Fairbanks?
faq.answer: Fairbanks lies hidden in the Cathedral wing of the Scarlet Monastery. Enter the side chapel to the right of the main altar and pull the concealed wall torch. It opens a secret stone doorway into a secluded crypt.

faq.q: Why is Fairbanks an undead creature?
faq.answer: No one has explained exactly how Fairbanks rose. At Stratholme, he lay buried beneath piles of Scourge corpses. After the Scarlet Crusade executed him for accusing its leaders, they cast his body into a hidden chamber, where it eventually rose as undead.

faq.q: Who was Fairbanks before he was executed?
faq.answer: Before his execution, Fairbanks was a devout priest of the Knights of the Silver Hand and chief counselor to Highlord Alexandros Mograine, bearer of the Ashbringer. He was among the original spiritual leaders of Lordaeron’s surviving defenders.

faq.q: What caused the split between the Scarlet Crusade and the Argent Dawn?
faq.answer: Fairbanks’s account of what he witnessed at Stratholme fractured the order. Those who believed him and rejected Renault’s fanaticism left to establish the Argent Dawn. Renault’s zealots remained with the Scarlet Crusade.

faq.q: Why did the Scarlet Crusade kill Fairbanks?
faq.answer: The Scarlet Crusade’s leaders called Fairbanks’s testimony about Stratholme malicious blasphemy. They executed him to silence the truth.

faq.q: Who replaced Fairbanks as High Inquisitor?
faq.answer: After Fairbanks’s execution and secret imprisonment, Whitemane became High Inquisitor. She led the Scarlet Monastery’s inquisitorial interrogations alongside Commander Renault Mograine.

angles.text: Fairbanks witnessed the Silver Hand’s darkest hour, when an honored paladin turned a legendary holy blade against his own father.
Before his fall, Fairbanks was a priest of the Light and Highlord Mograine’s closest counselor.
Fairbanks reveals the Scarlet Crusade’s hypocrisy: they hid one of their own dead behind an altar while burning innocent Forsaken.
Fairbanks’s tragedy began in fallen Lordaeron, where the Grand Alliance’s remnants split into zealots and outcasts.
